ROW.COLUMN: (ML/CU) Change in Beneficiary/Owner Followed by Surrender

One method of laundering money through insurance products is for a customer to initiate a policy with "dirty" money, change the beneficiary or owner, and then surrender it soon thereafter. This allows the "new" beneficiary or owner to receive "clean" funds from the insurance company. The scenario considers changes to key insurance policy elements, such as changes to beneficiaries, changes in policy ownership, and address changes.
Primary rule uses change log data to find change in beneficiary or owner. It also calculates the surrender amount for alert generation.

-------------------------------------------- Summarization of the logic -------------------------------------------- -- The alias AP finds out the latest beneficiary/owner change date for a customer.In this alias the filter --- -- for Filter for Lookbook Period Start < Latest Policy's Beneficiary or Owner Change Date has been applied. --- -- The alias FREQ_POLICY counts the no. of policies surrendered by a customer in the frequency period.This count--- -- is later checked in the outer query to be >=1 so that the scenario does not generate duplicate alerts. --- -- The alias RISK calculates the Overall Risk for a customer based on its effective risk and the activity risk --- -- of the surrender transaction in lookback period. --- -- The having clause check that if only one policy has been surrendered then Min Indiv Surrender Amt is --- -- taken else Min Total Surrender Amt is taken for the filter condition ---
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-------------------------------------------- Summarization of the logic -------------------------------------------- -- The alias AP finds out the latest beneficiary/OWNR change date for a customer.In this alias the filter --- -- for Filter for Lookbook Period Start < Latest Policy's Beneficiary or OWNR Change Date has been applied. --- -- The alias FREQ_POLICY counts the no. of policies surrendered by a customer in the frequency period.This count--- -- is later checked in the outer query to be >=1 so that the scenario does not generate duplicate alerts. --- -- The alias RISK calculates the Overall Risk for a customer based on its effective risk and the activity risk --- -- of the surrender transaction in lookback period. --- -- The having clause check that if only one policy has been surrendered then Min Indiv Surrender Amt is --- -- taken else Min Total Surrender Amt is taken for the filter condition ---
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
select RISK.cust_intrl_id,RISK.cust_seq_id, sum(it.trxn_base_am) SRNDR_AM, count(distinct ip.nsrnc_plcy_intrl_id) Srndr_Plcy_Ct, min(ip.plcy_srndr_dt - ap.POLICY_CHANGE_DT) Min_Lag from ---------- Alias to find the Latest Policy's Beneficiary or OWNR Change Date ---------- (select t.chg_nsrnc_plcy_intrl_id NCRNC_PLCY_INTRL_ID, max(t.CHANGE_DT) POLICY_CHANGE_DT FROM ( ---- Using key1_tx according to CR31095 --------------- (SELECT cl1.key1_tx chg_nsrnc_plcy_intrl_id, max(cl1.CHG_DT) CHANGE_DT from @BUSINESS@.CHG_LOG cl1 where upper(cl1.TBL_NM) = 'INSURANCE_POLICY_CUST' -------- Filter for Lookbook Period Start < Latest Policy's Beneficiary or OWNR Change Date ----
and cl1.chg_dt > (select add_months(CLNDR_DT, -@Lookback_Period) from @MANTAS@.kdd_cal where clndr_day_age = 0 and clndr_nm = 'SYSCAL') and upper(cl1.COL_NM) = 'CUST_NSRNC_PLCY_ROLE_CD' group by cl1.key1_tx) union all
(select cl2.key1_tx chg_nsrnc_plcy_intrl_id, max(cl2.chg_dt) CHANGE_DT from @BUSINESS@.chg_log cl2 where -------- Filter for Lookbook Period Start < Latest Policy's Beneficiary or OWNR Change Date ----
cl2.chg_dt > (select add_months(CLNDR_DT, -@Lookback_Period) from @MANTAS@.kdd_cal where clndr_day_age = 0 and clndr_nm = 'SYSCAL') and upper(cl2.tbl_nm) = 'ACCT_ADDR' group by cl2.key1_tx)) t GROUP BY t.chg_nsrnc_plcy_intrl_id
) AP,
@BUSINESS@.insurance_policy IP, @BUSINESS@.insurance_policy_cust IPC1, @BUSINESS@.insurance_trxn it, @BUSINESS@.insurance_product iprd,
--- Alias to find the no. of policies surrendered in frequency period --------- (select ipc3.cust_intrl_id, count(distinct ip1.nsrnc_plcy_intrl_id) Policy_Ct from @BUSINESS@.insurance_policy IP1, @BUSINESS@.insurance_policy_cust IPC3 where ip1.nsrnc_plcy_intrl_id = ipc3.nsrnc_plcy_intrl_id and ip1.plcy_srndr_dt <= (select kc3.clndr_dt from @MANTAS@.kdd_cal kc3 where kc3.clndr_day_age = 0 and kc3.clndr_nm = 'SYSCAL') and ip1.plcy_srndr_dt > (select add_months(kc4.clndr_dt, -@Frequency_Period) from @MANTAS@.kdd_cal kc4 where kc4.clndr_day_age = 0 and kc4.clndr_nm = 'SYSCAL') and ipc3.cust_nsrnc_plcy_role_cd = 'OWNR' group by ipc3.cust_intrl_id -------- Filter for at least one policy in frequency period ------------- having count(distinct ip1.nsrnc_plcy_intrl_id) >=1 ) FREQ_POLICY,
---- Alias for Calculating the Overall Risk ---------------- (select case when max(it2.nsrnc_trxn_actvy_risk_nb) >= @Actvty_Risk_Cutoff_Lvl and max(c1.cust_efctv_risk_nb) >= @Effctv_Risk_Cutoff_Lvl then 'HR' else case when max(it2.nsrnc_trxn_actvy_risk_nb) < @Actvty_Risk_Cutoff_Lvl and max(c1.cust_efctv_risk_nb) < @Effctv_Risk_Cutoff_Lvl then 'RR' else 'MR' end end Overall_Risk, c1.cust_intrl_id, c1.cust_seq_id from @BUSINESS@.insurance_trxn it2, @BUSINESS@.insurance_policy_cust ipc4, @BUSINESS@.cust c1 where it2.nsrnc_plcy_intrl_id = ipc4.nsrnc_plcy_intrl_id and c1.cust_intrl_id = ipc4.cust_intrl_id and it2.mantas_trxn_purp_cd = 'SURRENDER' and ipc4.cust_nsrnc_plcy_role_cd = 'OWNR' and (@All_Jurisdictions_Fl = 'Y' or c1.jrsdcn_cd in (@Incl_Jurisdictions_Lst)) and it2.trxn_dt >= (select add_months(clndr_dt, -@Lookback_Period) from @MANTAS@.kdd_cal where clndr_day_age = 0 and clndr_nm = 'SYSCAL') and it2.trxn_dt < (select clndr_dt from @MANTAS@.kdd_cal where clndr_day_age = 0 and clndr_nm = 'SYSCAL') and c1.cust_efctv_risk_nb <> -2 group by c1.cust_intrl_id,c1.cust_seq_id) RISK
where ip.nsrnc_plcy_intrl_id = ap.NCRNC_PLCY_INTRL_ID and ip.nsrnc_plcy_intrl_id = Ipc1.Nsrnc_Plcy_Intrl_Id and it.nsrnc_plcy_intrl_id = ip.nsrnc_plcy_intrl_id and ipc1.cust_intrl_id = RISK.cust_intrl_id
----- Filter on policy where Latest Policy's Beneficiary or OWNR Change Date <= Policy Surrender Date ---- and ip.plcy_srndr_dt >= ap.POLICY_CHANGE_DT
and FREQ_POLICY.cust_intrl_id = ipc1.cust_intrl_id and iprd.nsrnc_prdct_intrl_id = ip.nsrnc_prdct_intrl_id and (@All_Insurance_Type_Fl = 'Y' or iprd.nsrnc_type_cd in (@Incl_Insurance_Type_Lst)) and iprd.prem_type_cd in (@Incl_Premium_Type_Lst) and ip.plcy_srndr_dt is not null and it.mantas_trxn_purp_cd = 'SURRENDER' and ipc1.cust_nsrnc_plcy_role_cd = 'OWNR'
------- Filter for Policy Surrender Date - Max Surrender Period <= Latest Policy's Beneficiary/OWNR Change Date ---- and add_months(ip.plcy_srndr_dt,- (case risk.Overall_Risk when 'HR' then @HR_Max_Srndr_Prd when 'RR' then @RR_Max_Srndr_Prd else @MR_Max_Srndr_Prd end)) <= ap.POLICY_CHANGE_DT
group by RISK.cust_intrl_id, risk.Overall_Risk,risk.cust_seq_id
----- Checkpoint conditions -------------- having sum(it.trxn_base_am) >= (case count(distinct ip.nsrnc_plcy_intrl_id) when 1 then(case risk.Overall_Risk when 'HR' then @HR_Min_Indiv_Srndr_Am when 'RR' then @RR_Min_Indiv_Srndr_Am else @MR_Min_Indiv_Srndr_Am end) else(case risk.Overall_Risk when 'HR' then @HR_Min_Tot_Srndr_Am when 'RR' then @RR_Min_Tot_Srndr_Am else @MR_Min_Tot_Srndr_Am end) end)
